name: AD_ID permission
plain: Android 13 apps must declare AD_ID in the manifest to read the advertising ID.
meaning: If missing, the ID reads as zeros. Cuts ad tracking in apps that did not declare it.

android.persistence: Static in manifest; SDKs may merge it in
android.revocation: Cannot be revoked per app (user can delete the ad ID)
android.store_policy: Play: must declare when targeting API 33 and using ad ID

limits.headline: Can use the Android ad ID only if the app lists the AD_ID permission
limits.user_action: Nothing. It is switched on automatically when the app installs
can: Use the Google advertising ID if the app lists AD_ID
Get it with no prompt, since it is auto granted
Give zeros if the app left it out (Android 13 and later)
cannot: Get the real ID without the permission, on apps built for Android 13
Work on iPhone; the tracking prompt guards the ID there
limits.reach_label: Ongoing, if listed by the app
limits.differs: Android 13 and later only. iPhone uses the tracking prompt instead.

story.what_it_is: A line apps must add on Android 13 and later to read your advertising ID.

marketing.name: AD_ID permission
marketing.pitch: Apps targeting Android 13 must declare AD_ID to use the advertising ID.

story.for_you: You do not see a prompt. If an app has not declared it, its advertising ID reads as zeros, so ads cannot follow you from that app.
story.for_makers: Without the line, the advertising ID returns zeros. It cuts ad tracking in apps that skip the declaration and signals to Play reviewers that an app uses ads.

use_cases.example: A game with ads adds the declaration so its ad network can still see the ID.
A kids app leaves it out on purpose, so the ID is always zeros.
A retailer declares it so install attribution works.
An ad SDK checks for the permission and falls back to contextual ads.
Play checks the manifest and the Data safety form for matching claims.
A developer finds the ID suddenly returns zeros after updating the target version.

story.android_note: Added in Android 13 as a normal permission.
story.ios_note: iOS uses the ATT prompt instead.

technical_bounds: Visible to Play Console and store scanners

history.change: Permission introduced; zeros if undeclared when targeting 13
